grants.description: The purpose of this award is to build and strengthen agricultural cooperatives in Rwanda, Zambia and Ghana.
John Ogonowski and Doug Bereuter Farmer-to-Farmer (F2F) Program

The purpose of the management of Fall Armyworm in Maize is to deploy an integrated pest management (IPM) strategy to combat FAW that will enhance food security and income generation, and improve the livelihoods of maize producers in the maize production zones of the DRC
